shortDescription: Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and Moonshot AI relied heavily on outputs from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model to train their latest models, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
